gold.historyOfPresentIllness: The patient is an 85-year-old male presenting with recurrent urinary tract infections characterized by frequent, painful, and urgent urination. He reports that symptoms have persisted intermittently for several weeks despite previous treatment with nitrofurantoin. He denies abdominal or flank pain but notes difficulty with bowel movements following a prior colon resection.
